title: Dawa Capital Website
description: Modern responsive frontend for an AI-powered private capital markets platform (built with .NET backend).
longDescription: Developed the complete frontend (UI/UX) for Dawa Capital – an AI-powered operating system for private capital markets. The platform automates the full deal lifecycle (deal creation, KYC/AML compliance, investor matching, data rooms, escrow/settlement, and secondary trading) using governed AI agents. Built a clean, modern, and highly responsive interface using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript focused on clarity, compliance transparency, and smooth user experience for issuers, investors, and brokers.

title: AI Interview Platform
description: Full-stack AI-powered platform for mock interviews, real interviews, resume tools, and career counseling.
longDescription: A complete full-stack platform for AI-powered mock interviews and real interview simulations. Features include a resume builder, resume improvement tool, career counseling chatbot, and role-based access control for companies and candidates. Built both frontend and backend with real-time AI integration using Next.js, Prisma, Firebase, Gemini API, and Ollama LLM.

title: Army Canine – Dog Breeding System
description: Full-stack pedigree tracking system with inbreeding risk calculation for dog breeders.
longDescription: Full-stack web application that tracks dog family history up to 5 generations, automatically calculates inbreeding risks to prevent genetic diseases, and helps breeders make informed, safe breeding decisions. Includes complete user interface and backend logic.

title: Weather Forecast App
description: Real-time weather app with current conditions, hourly & 7-day forecast using Weather API.
longDescription: A clean and modern Weather Application that fetches real-time weather data using a Weather API (OpenWeatherMap). Features include current temperature, weather conditions, hourly forecast, 7-day forecast, location-based search, and beautiful UI with dynamic backgrounds. Built with Flutter for smooth cross-platform performance.

title: GearAid – Vehicle Help App
description: Flutter mobile app that connects drivers with mechanics during breakdowns with real-time tracking.
longDescription: Award-winning final year project: A Flutter mobile application designed as 'first-aid for vehicles'. Connects users in distress with nearby mechanics using real-time location tracking, booking system, and secure payments. Presented at UOBS Tech Expo 2024 and received Certificate of Appreciation from University of Baltistan.

title: E-Commerce App
description: Full-featured Flutter mobile shopping app with real-time updates and secure payments.
longDescription: Complete cross-platform e-commerce mobile application built with Flutter and Firebase. Includes product catalog, shopping cart, user authentication, real-time inventory updates, and secure payment integration. Designed with clean, responsive UI/UX.
